description: Partner tree node detail view for administrative management of organizational hierarchies. Allows viewing and editing partner tree structure, relationships, and hierarchical data.

pages.name: PartnerTreeDetailsComponent
pages.description: This page provides a detailed view of a specific node within the partner organizational tree. Users can view, manage, and edit the organizational details, relationships, and hierarchical positioning of a partner. This is crucial for maintaining an accurate representation of the company's organizational structure and reporting lines.

help_guidance.when_stuck: This page displays detailed information about a specific node in your partner organizational tree. If you're unsure what to do, review the existing organizational information and relationships. You can use the available form fields (if any are present) to modify details such as the partner's name, type, or its position within the hierarchy. Any changes you make here will directly impact how this partner appears in organizational charts and other hierarchical views across the system. Ensure all changes accurately reflect your company's structure.
common_tasks: Viewing tree node details: To understand a partner's place in the hierarchy, simply navigate to this page for the specific partner. Review the displayed organizational information and its relationships to other nodes.
Editing organizational data: To update a partner's details, locate the relevant fields on the page (e.g., name, description, type) and enter the new information. Remember to save any changes.

Managing relationships: To change a partner's parent or child relationships within the organization tree, look for fields or sections related to 'Parent' or 'Children'. Select the appropriate new parent or link/unlink child nodes as needed.

Configuring hierarchy: To adjust a partner's position or reporting lines, modify the hierarchical fields to ensure proper organizational positioning. This might involve changing its direct parent or its level in the tree.

Updating structure: To make broader changes to how the organization is represented, modify the relevant fields that define the partner's role and connections within the system's organizational structure.
help_guidance.getting_started: To get started, select a partner from the main partner tree view to open its detailed information page. Here, you can explore all the attributes and relationships of that specific partner node. Familiarize yourself with the displayed data before attempting any edits.
